name: Vikram (Chandrayaan-2)
site_name: South polar region, near Manzinus C and Simpelius N
left: Impact point, debris field and disturbed soil (September 2019)
fact: India's first attempt at a soft landing on the Moon. Vikram lost contact at about 2.1 km altitude during its powered descent and crashed in September 2019. NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter found the impact point and the debris field in images taken in October and November 2019, after a member of the public spotted the first debris in the first mosaic.
capability: None: the lander was lost. The Chandrayaan-2 orbiter kept working.
